title: Use complete-Run CPU attribution to select a hypothesis
question: Which current user-CPU costs justify a bounded next experiment?
summary: Investigate fixed-size spool-key decoding; sampled CPU shares are hypothesis selection, not predicted speedups.

workloads: Two complete Runs of the pinned default source, release debug metadata and recorded perf capture/recovery.

validation.summary: Pinned source, perf capture/recovery, independent output verifier and provenance records support attribution of the captured build.

limitations: CPU attribution applies to its pinned build and workload; later default changes can alter the cost distribution.
Stack samples and unresolved caller attribution do not establish isolated component costs.
exclusions: No sampled CPU share is converted into a whole-job gain or pooled with a later experiment.
